runes.name: Power Rune
runes.effect: Increases skill damage at the cost of higher energy cost

runes.name: Efficiency Rune
runes.effect: Reduces energy cost at the cost of lower damage

runes.name: Spread Rune
runes.effect: Increases AOE target count at the cost of per-target damage

runes.name: Focus Rune
runes.effect: Increases crit chance at the cost of lower base damage

runes.name: Endurance Rune
runes.effect: Skill ignores target DEF at the cost of lower damage

runes.name: Pierce Rune
runes.effect: Skill cannot be evaded, at the cost of lower damage

runes.name: Frost Conversion Rune
runes.effect: Converts any elemental skill to Frost. Burn effects become Freeze.

runes.name: Shock Conversion Rune
runes.effect: Converts any skill to Lightning. Adds WET synergy priming.

runes.name: Void Conversion Rune
runes.effect: Converts damage to TRUE, ignoring target DEF entirely.

runes.name: Multi-Shot Rune
runes.effect: Single-target skill hits +2 additional targets.

runes.name: Chain Bounce Rune
runes.effect: Skill arcs to additional targets. +1/2/3 bounces.

runes.name: Spread Blast Rune
runes.effect: Upgrades single-target to AOE_LARGE.

runes.name: Precise Focus Rune
runes.effect: AOE skill becomes single-target with massive damage boost.

runes.name: Fragment Rune
runes.effect: Splits one hit into 3 weaker hits (0.4x each).

runes.name: Barrage Rune
runes.effect: Splits one hit into 5 very weak hits (0.25x each). Great vs shields.

runes.name: Ground Fire Rune
runes.effect: Leaves burning ground at target location. Burns enemies for 2 turns.

runes.name: Frost Patch Rune
runes.effect: Leaves a frost patch that slows all enemies for 2 turns.

runes.name: Poison Cloud Rune
runes.effect: Leaves a poisonous cloud that damages enemies for 3 turns.

runes.name: Poison Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Adds poison to any skill.

runes.name: Bleed Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Adds bleed to any skill.

runes.name: Burn Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Adds burn to any skill.

runes.name: Freeze Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Adds a chance to freeze the target.

runes.name: Shock Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Adds shock status. Combines with WET for automatic stun.

runes.name: Stun Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Adds a chance to stun the target.

runes.name: Silence Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Silences the target - cannot use abilities.

runes.name: Blind Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Blinds the target - reduces accuracy.

runes.name: Curse Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Curses the target - reduces all stats.

runes.name: Fear Infusion Rune
runes.effect: Slows target and has a small chance to stun from terror.

runes.name: Lifesteal Rune
runes.effect: Heal for 25% of damage dealt.

runes.name: Mana Drain Rune
runes.effect: Restore energy on hit.

runes.name: Soul Rip Rune
runes.effect: Lifesteal 50% + executes targets below 20% HP (true damage).

runes.name: Knockback Rune
runes.effect: Knocks the target back, applying slow.

runes.name: Pull Rune
runes.effect: Pulls the target, with a chance to root.

runes.name: Taunt Rune
runes.effect: Forces target to attack you next turn.

runes.name: Quick Cast Rune
runes.effect: Cooldown -1 turn (min 0), but +25% energy cost.

runes.name: Efficient Cast Rune
runes.effect: Energy cost -40%, but -15% damage.

runes.name: Cooldown Rune
runes.effect: Reduces skill cooldown. Higher tiers can halve or remove it entirely.

runes.name: Wet Rune
runes.effect: Applies WET to affected targets. Reduces movement stability, enables Shock/Frost/Burn synergies.

runes.name: Star Rune
runes.effect: Applies STELLAR to affected targets. Increases crit damage for user, chance to inflict BURN.
